finding: pool-worker.ts `keepSymbol` carries a UNIVERSAL denylist of names it calls keywords or tree-sitter artifacts: this, super, self, Self, me, My, destructor, root, program, source_file, module_declaration, package_manifest, GlobalScope, SCSS_FILE_SCOPE, unknown. GraphQL has NO keyword named `me` — it is an ordinary field name in most public APIs — so a correct analyzer symbol is deleted on the way to the store, and every relationship sourced on it is stored naming nothing. `pool-worker.ts` is shared machinery (all 46 lanes), so this probe measures and names it rather than editing it.
